title: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!
description: The flagship attraction, "Twilight Cruise," is waiting for professional testers...

mainQuestExcel.title: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!
mainQuestExcel.description: The flagship attraction, "Twilight Cruise," is waiting for professional testers...

dialogs.text: You're here! Looks like the staff had to step out for a bit, but I've pretty much figured out how to take it for a spin... ahem, yeah, for testing purposes!
Great, then show us the ropes!
Basically, one person rides the boat while the other sends signals to the saurian staff. Working as a team, the aim is to safely guide the boat to its destination.
#So I'm pretty confident — 'cause when it comes to teamwork, {NICKNAME} and I have it down to a T!
Oh really? Well, don't get too confident, or you might end up capsizing...
Whoa, Paimon, don't go around jinxing people!
Okay, okay... Then Paimon wishes you... smooth sailing?
Hehe, that goes without saying.
I'm actually kind of in the mood to ride the boat. I'm used to tough surfing challenges, so it'll be fun to switch it up!
I'm kinda tired of the Waverider too.
See, we're in perfect sync already! That's gotta be proof of our bond, huh?
Can't wait to pump up my inflatable swimsuit and bounce right onto the boat!
I'll take care of the signals.
...Oh, so the facilities here are still under construction.
Look, there's an iktomisaur employee! Should we ask him for help?
Hi there! Any chance you could give us a hand getting these built?
Um... Put... here... and build...
Doesn't look like he understands...
Yeah... Hmm, what should we do now?
...Ohhhhh, hold on! A stroke of genius just came to me!
Eee!
Eee! Eee! Eee!
Hah, nope... Well at least we know he doesn't speak koholasaur!
Why don't we just—
Oh, I've got another idea!
What now?
I once heard Ifa mention that iktomisaurs go wild for Glowing Hornshrooms, and guess what I happen to have on me...?
This has gotta be it! Once he eats this, we'll totally be on the same wavelength!
There's no such thing as packing too much when you're heading out on a long trip... Kachina was spot on. Gotta remember to thank her for this...
Uhhh, whatever that was, it's definitely not the wavelength Paimon's on...
What a disaster... Day one, and there goes my dream of conquering all the challenges in Wavey Bay...
#Got any ideas, {NICKNAME}, o great hero of Natlan...?
Well, there's always one option...
#Okay, let's try that. Appreciate it, {NICKNAME}!
I can fetch another iktomisaur to help.
You return, having indwelt an iktomisaurus...
Mualani, we're back!
#Oh, hey there! Aww, aren't you just the cutest? Wait, where'd {NICKNAME} go?
#Uh, {M#he}{F#she}... {M#His}{F#Her} stomach started acting up, so {M#he}{F#she} had to run to the bathroom...
(Seriously Paimon, that's such a lame cover story. Never mind, as long as Mualani buys it...)
My, you're a friendly one! Wanna try a Glowing Hornshroom? Here, have at it!
(A curious flavor, indeed. Thick, juicy, and surprisingly delicious, for a mushroom...)
Haha, glad you liked it! Here, they're all yours.
C—Can I pet you? C'mon, let's be friends!
Also, could you... do me a favor?

flow.stepDescription: Use the ability of an Iktomisaur to complete construction

dialogs.text: What is she yammering on about!? I don't understand. My friend asked me to look after this place... No one said anything about manual labor...
But those mushrooms tasted nice... If it means I can get some more of them...
What is she yammering on about!? I don't understand. My friend asked me to look after this place... No one said anything about manual labor...
But those mushrooms tasted nice... If it means I can get some more of them...
Phew, looks like we're all done!
Thank you! I couldn't have done it without your help.
Mind if I pet you again? Aww, that's a good little buddy... You're the best!
Um... Mualani, it's probably about time we took our friend back home.
#Oh, sure. I'll wait here in case {NICKNAME} gets back in the meantime.
Such cute little things! Maybe I should get Granny to teach me some iktomisaur...
#Oh, hey {NICKNAME}, how's the stomach?
Absolutely fine, thanks.
Glad to hear it. Oh, you won't believe it — you just missed the sweetest little iktomisaur! Seriously, so adorable!
It almost makes me wanna go stay with the Masters of the Night-Wind for a while, just so I can pick some more Glowing Hornshrooms and spend some time bonding with them!
